question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Filthy
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"filthy"** means something that is extremely dirty or unclean. (बहुत गंदा)

 
 
• **Example: **The room was** filthy** after the party, with trash scattered everywhere.
 
 
 
• **"Dirty"** refers to something that is not clean, soiled, or covered with dirt. (गंदा)
 
 
• **Example: **His clothes were** dirty** after playing in the mud all day.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'filthy'** is **'dirty'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tidy **(साफ-सुथरा): Neat and in good order.

 
 
• **Example:** She always keeps her room **tidy **and organized.
 
 
 
• **Visual **(दृश्य): Related to seeing or sight.
 
 
• **Example:** The **visual **effects in the movie were stunning.
 
 
 
• **Shiny **(चमकदार): Reflecting light, bright.
 
 
• **Example:** The new car had a **shiny**, polished surface.
